}

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect an OTCA workflow that enables cross-tenant model improvements while maintaining strict regional data residency and immutable auditing.

## Key Concepts
- OTCA residency, secure aggregation, cross-tenant model updates
- Region-specific streaming (Kafka topics) and immutable logs
- Privacy budget (epsilon) handling per tenant
- Drift detection and burst/throughput testing

## Code Example
```javascript
function withinBudget(tenant, delta, budgets, cap) {
  budgets[tenant] = (budgets[tenant] || 0) + delta;
  return budgets[tenant] <= cap;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale the cross-tenant aggregator for thousands of tenants?
- Which cryptographic technique would you prefer for secure aggregation and why?
